outcome: Prevalence of ovarian tumors in pregnancy
Fetal loss following surgery during pregnancy
Adnexectomy procedure timing relative to delivery
cohort: The study included 41,842 pregnant women, among whom 190 patients were diagnosed with ovarian tumors during pregnancy.
finding: The prevalence of ovarian tumors during pregnancy was 4.5 per 1,000 pregnant women, with mature cystic teratoma being the most common histopathological finding, and fetal loss occurring in 18.75% of cases following surgery during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Adnexectomy was performed predominantly with cesarean delivery (93 cases) compared to after vaginal delivery (1 case).
